technical.title: Hy-Nomas video world model enables free-form interactive world generation
technical.summary: Hy-Nomas is an 8B diffusion video world model supporting free-form text instructions and continuous camera control by aligning structured captions with action-aware causal attention.
technical.why: It advances video world models for complex, multi-turn agentic or robotic simulations.

technical.title: Aerial-R1 framework reinforces visual reasoning and segmentation in aerial MLLMs
technical.summary: Aerial-R1 addresses severe hallucinations and scale variations in aerial computer vision by reinforcing visual reasoning and uncertainty modeling in MLLMs.
technical.why: It provides a new approach for handling extreme scale variations and ambiguity in aerial perception.

technical.title: MoViD algorithm performs real-time motion detection inspired by photonic time stretch
technical.summary: MoViD is a physics-inspired motion estimation algorithm designed to overcome the limitations of optical flow and background subtraction in complex computer vision scenes.
technical.why: It introduces a novel physics-grounded mechanism for robust real-time motion perception in robotics and autonomous vehicles.

technical.title: Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B-A9B hybrid vision-language model released for local AI
technical.summary: Nvidia introduces a hybrid Mamba-Transformer vision-language model optimized via Star Elastic compression and quantization-aware distillation for local agentic and vision workloads.
technical.why: It provides an efficient local architecture optimized for memory-constrained agentic and vision tasks.

technical.title: RoboWorM benchmark evaluates movement realism and spatiotemporal fidelity in VWMs
technical.summary: RoboWorM is a deployment-aware benchmark using hardware priors and kinematic trees to evaluate robotic video world models across 1,605 episodes.
technical.why: It enables rigorous evaluation of embodied video world models using true 3D spatial and kinematic constraints.

technical.title: Omni-InteractScope benchmark evaluates proactive omnimodal interaction in continuous streams
technical.summary: Researchers introduce Omni-InteractScope, a benchmark with 1,479 human-annotated interactions across eight task groups to evaluate omnimodal LLMs on continuous audiovisual streams.
technical.why: It helps engineers assess how reliably models connect stream evidence to timely interventions.

technical.title: Tsinghua AI open-sources AKV cache engineering server for LLM agents
technical.summary: Tsinghua researchers released AKV, an SGLang-based serving system that lets LLM agents manage KV cache directly, cutting average costs by 27.7% across four agent benchmarks.
technical.why: It offers practical infrastructure optimization for reducing the serving costs of agentic LLMs.

technical.title: Review examines causal-based approaches to explain and learn from self-extension
technical.summary: This paper reviews how causal approaches help autonomous robots internalize and understand the reasons behind their perceptions and actions beyond immediate responses.
technical.why: It addresses core reliability and transparency limitations in modern deep learning robotics.

technical.title: Measuring the counterfactual effect of reasoning effort in LLM agents
technical.summary: This work measures the counterfactual effect of inference-time reasoning effort on proprietary and open models, treating reasoning effort as a credence good.
technical.why: It highlights the economic and efficiency trade-offs of scaling compute for agentic tasks.

business.title: Global robotics startup venture funding jumps to $9.9 billion in Q3
business.summary: Venture funding to robotics startups soared in 2026, reaching $9.9 billion in Q3 compared to $4.3 billion in Q3 2025, driven by the U.S. and China.
business.why: This surge highlights rapid capital influx into physical AI and autonomous systems.

business.title: Anthropic officially files for a public stock market debut
business.summary: Anthropic officially filed for an IPO, revealing soaring revenue, mounting losses, and an unusual governance structure to preserve its safety mission.
business.why: The public listing of a major frontier lab sets new financial and operational benchmarks for the AI industry.

business.title: Meta raises $95 billion to support artificial intelligence infrastructure investments
business.summary: Meta announced plans to raise $95 billion to support its investments in artificial intelligence infrastructure.
business.why: This massive capital raise highlights the scaling costs of foundational AI infrastructure.

business.title: SK Hynix shares soar after beating third-quarter profit estimates
business.summary: SK Hynix shares soared over 8% after its third-quarter profit sharply beat estimates, with the chipmaker returning $25 billion to investors.
business.why: Hardware supplier profitability reflects the ongoing heavy demand for specialized AI chips.

business.title: General Compute raises $100 million Series A for alternative inference chips
business.summary: General Compute raised a $100 million Series A round to bet on inference chips from outside the Nvidia ecosystem.
business.why: Diversification in hardware vendors impacts cost structures for deploying computer vision and AI models.

business.title: Highway thieves steal $100 million in data center equipment via GPS spoofing
business.summary: Investigators explained how highway thieves used GPS spoofing to steal $100 million in data center-bound cargo.
business.why: Physical security vulnerabilities can directly disrupt supply chains for critical AI hardware.

business.title: SoftBank plans $50 billion technology investment in Malaysia's AI sector
business.summary: SoftBank Group reportedly plans to invest $50 billion in Malaysia's technology sector, focusing on artificial intelligence and data centers.
business.why: International investments shape global infrastructure availability for AI workloads.

business.title: Amazon set to make major returns from Anthropic public offering
business.summary: Massive note conversions reveal the true extent of Amazon's ownership in Anthropic ahead of its public debut.
business.why: Strategic tech giant partnerships heavily influence the commercialization and funding landscape of frontier AI labs.

business.title: Anthropic discloses earnings and risks in 335-page IPO filing
business.summary: In an S-1 filing preceding its public debut, Anthropic laid out extensive new details about its earnings, growth, and risks.
business.why: S-1 filings offer rare financial transparency into the actual operational costs of training and running frontier models.

business.title: Anthropic plans governance structure to maintain safety mission post-IPO
business.summary: Anthropic aims to tap public markets while maintaining its core mission of developing AI safely through an elaborate governance structure.
business.why: Commercial pressures can conflict with safety measures in autonomous systems and frontier AI development.

models.title: MiniMax-M3.1-Flash Native Multimodal MoE Model Released with 1M Context
models.summary: MiniMax-M3.1-Flash is a native multimodal mixture-of-experts model supporting text, image, and video inputs with a context window up to 1M tokens, using sparse attention and DSpark speculative decoding for high efficiency.
models.why: It matters for large-context multimodal processing and agentic workflows.

models.title: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 Update Improves Reasoning and Visual Benchmarks
models.summary: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 is a minor update delivering substantial improvements across reasoning, coding, agentic tasks, and visual benchmarks while reducing task execution time and output length.
models.why: It matters because it advances the performance-cost Pareto frontier for multimodal and agentic tasks.

models.title: Non-Uniform GGUF Quantizations Released for DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017
models.summary: This repository provides non-uniform GGUF quantizations of a 763B-parameter, 384-expert MoE produced with GSQ and RCO, updated to use llama.cpp's DeepSeek-V4.1 layout including image support.
models.why: It matters for running massive MoE visual models locally using llama.cpp.

models.title: Sage-A1.5 35B Mixture-of-Experts Agentic Model Released for Scientific Problem Solving
models.summary: Sage-A1.5 is a 35B MoE agentic model based on Qwen3.6 and Agents-A1, built to advance long-horizon scientific problem solving through adaptive capability composition and work organization.
models.why: It matters for advancing long-horizon scientific reasoning and autonomous agent planning.

models.title: Recursive Introduces Flint Mixture-of-Experts Model for Coding Agents
models.summary: Flint is a mixture-of-experts language model for coding agents with 39.8 billion total parameters and 2.5 billion active per token, designed to investigate codebases, fix bugs, implement features, and write tests.
models.why: It matters as a specialized tool for codebases and multi-turn tool use.

models.title: Nanbeige4.3-33B Released as Flagship Teacher Model for Lightweight Agents
models.summary: Nanbeige4.3-33B is designed as a flagship teacher model for the Nanbeige4.3 series to anchor the distillation of advanced agentic capabilities into smaller models, excelling at complex coding and professional cowork tasks.
models.why: It matters for developers looking to distill agentic capabilities into smaller architectures.
